messages:
alice: Quick perf note — ran a microbatch sweep for streaming chat vs non-streaming completions on the A100 dedicated pool. Seeing a weird p99 tail for streaming when mb_size >= 8. summary + logs below.
marco: Can you paste the numbers? p50/p95/p99 and tokens/s for each mb size?
alice: Sure, quick snapshot (tokens/sec measured with `load-gen` 8x clients):
```
mode    mb_size  p50_ms  p95_ms  p99_ms  tokens_s
stream   1        45      110     160     1400
stream   4        60      170     420     4800
stream   8        75      310     980     9000
stream  16       130      650    1800    15000
nonstr   1        40      100     140     1600
nonstr   4        55      120     200     6000
nonstr   8        85      190     300     9800
nonstr  16       150      310     500    16000
```
(so streaming gets better tokens/s with larger mb but p99 explodes around 8+)
priya: Interesting — did you correlate with KV cache hit rate? I remember a regression where cold KV miss spikes tail.
alice: I did. KV cache hit% per run: 1->98%, 4->95%, 8->87%, 16->72%. The tail aligns with increased KV evictions and extra memcpy on cache refill. snippet from trace: `kv_cache_miss: 0.13 @client=3 layer=23`, repeated.
ben: Kernel selection might also be playing. On long sequences our kernel selector falls back to `generic_matmul` for some layers (layers near end) which is ~3-4x slower. If streaming chunking changes seq distribution we could be hitting a different codepath. Try forcing the fast kernel for a run.
alice: I sampled a profiler (tiny trimmed output):
```
[profiling] layer 22: selected_kernel=fast_attn_v2 (120ms)
[profiling] layer 23: selected_kernel=generic_matmul (430ms)
[memcpy] host->device 23: 20ms
[kv_op] refill layer 23: 180ms
```
marco: Ok. Two hypotheses: (A) kv cache thrash + memcpy causing tail; (B) kernel selector edge-case on mid/late layers when seq_len distribution changes. We should try controlled experiments.
alice: Plan to run 2 variants today:
1) kernel_override: force `fast_attn_v2` for all layers + keep mb_size=8 + same traffic (to isolate kernel).
2) tail_policy: reduce streaming chunk tokens to 8, enable `tail_smoothing=true`, and cap mb_size at 4 (to reduce kv churn).
config snippets:```json
{"microbatch_size":8, "kernel_override":"fast_attn_v2"}
{"microbatch_size":4, "streaming_chunk_tokens":8, "tail_smoothing":true}
```
priya: Also try a warmup phase: send synthetic prefix traffic for 30s to prefill KV for each session — that reduced tail in earlier experiments.
ben: When you run, capture p99 and qps + distribution of `kernel_selected` per layer. If kernel override fixes p99 but throughput drops, that's informative for tradeoff.
alice: Will run both with 4 nodes, same model binary, and post results here later today. ETA ~ 3h.
